text: Three hands-on programs run by the community. Join one, or help build them.

items.title: CEP Studio
items.text: A guided space to break down a complex engineering problem, map it to the P1–P7 attributes and shape a clear, defensible solution.
bullets: Problem framing and requirement mapping workshops
Peer review of analysis, reports and design trade-offs
Volunteer mentors from academia and industry

items.title: Concept Visualizer
items.text: Volunteers design and publish interactive explainers that make hard engineering and computing concepts intuitive — free for anyone to learn from.
bullets: Open, reusable explainers built with web technology
Design and coding sessions for first-time contributors

items.title: Venture Lab
items.text: Practical support for student and early-stage founders: test the idea, define the customer, build a lean prototype and tell the story.
bullets: Lean MVP planning and basic business modeling
Pitch practice with feedback from volunteer mentors
